title: Exact approval tab readiness
summary: The identity browser driver waits for the exact request URL or its canonical same-code organization route before approving; older tabs do not establish readiness. It reports machine_browser_sign_in_required when same-origin tabs show /auth/sign-in, /beta or /orgs/new instead of the approval page: the operator identity's login expired. Its recovery names the exact yoke browser authorize --project P --identity NAME --test-machine TEST_MACHINE command and says never to sign in inside that approval window. Evidence records paths with codes redacted and queries and fragments omitted. Absent and foreign-origin tabs keep machine_browser_tab_missing; when no identity browser runs at all, the same code carries state identity_browser_not_running. Host preparation refusals are unchanged.
